## Scan diagnostics and local fallback

- Save shareable scan failure reports with provider status codes and diagnostic context, without drawing contents, file paths, API keys, or raw exception messages.
- Show Ollama's error details locally and verify the server and model download before using the fallback.
- Expand the packaged Tesseract self-test with sample drawing identifiers.
